svg.text: IRIS AI V4 — Intelligent Voice-Controlled Desktop Assistant
How IRIS Understands, Plans, Executes, Verifies and Adapts to User Commands
Example: "Open Chrome and search for ChatGPT"
Captures the user's voice instantly and accurately
Converts spoken request into an actionable instruction
• What website or document is on screen?
• What text is selected or in clipboard?
• What project or file is open in the editor?
Inferred User Activity: Coding / Browsing / Meeting / Idle
Breaks request into exact steps needed to complete it
Reuses already open windows to avoid redundant actions
IRIS checks what the task may change before performing it
Prevents unintended file deletion or harmful changes
IRIS uses the safest and most reliable available method first
Interacts directly with native buttons, menus, input text fields and tabs for maximum speed and accuracy
Scans screen text visually to locate buttons or text labels when application controls are not directly accessible
Uses keyboard shortcuts, mouse clicks, and application process launching when visual controls are unavailable
IRIS does not simply assume the action worked.
Verifies: Did Chrome open? Did the search page appear?
IRIS checks what changed and looks for another way to complete the task
Insert popup dismissal or shortcut step
YES (↺ Try Again with New Method)
Saves successful actions & learned control shortcuts
Improves future speed and accuracy automatically
Successful actions + User preferences + Preferred apps
Suggestions are advisory (Always keeps user in control)
"Done. I opened Chrome and searched for ChatGPT."
Updates live IRIS Desktop Interface & HUD view
Remembers browser & search preferences for next time
LISTEN ➔ UNDERSTAND ➔ OBSERVE ➔ PLAN ➔ CHECK SAFETY ➔ ACT ➔ VERIFY ➔ RECOVER IF NEEDED ➔ LEARN ➔ RESPOND
A complete, self-healing, context-aware artificial intelligence desktop operator
